sn35.23:1.5: Cakkhuṃ ceva rūpā ca || Sotañca saddā ca || Ghānañca gandhā ca || Jivhā rasā ca || Kāyo ca phoṭṭhabbā ca || Mano ca dhammā ca || ||
sn35.23:1.8: Aham etaṃ sabbam paccakkhāya aññaṃ sabbam paññāpessāmīti || tassa vācāvatthur evassa ||
sn35.23:1.9: puṭṭho ca na sampāpeyya || uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjeyya || ||
